labels.fixed_residual: fp32 arm reuses the bf16 arm's d(-logp)/d(model output): only the model Jacobian (forward+backward compute precision) differs
labels.own_residual: fp32 arm uses its own log-prob residual on the bf16-sampled trajectory (adds the bf16-vs-fp32 mean mismatch)
labels.fixed_residual_terminal_excluded.per_ste: UNWEIGHTED sum over samples, all steps incl. terminal; training-relevant per-step numbers are per_step_w_*
labels.fixed_residual_terminal_excluded.(batch|: mean over the non-terminal steps, fixed_residual fp32 reference
labels.advantages: synthetic: standard normal draws, centred per prompt group, divided by their overall std
labels.logp: CPS 'log-prob' is the unscaled negative mean squared residual, not a normalised Gaussian log-likelihood
